knowledgeDocs.title: company-info
knowledgeDocs.body: Maple & Moss is a small apparel brand based in Portland, OR, est. 2019. We sell boots, denim, and knitwear. Customer support is run by Robin. We pride ourselves on a warm, personal reply to every customer.

knowledgeDocs.title: product-info
knowledgeDocs.body:
PRODUCT NOTES.
Birch overshirt colors: Ecru (warm off-white), Sage (a muted olive green), and Slate (blue-grey). NOTE: on-screen color depends on the customer's display, and we cannot confirm whether a particular lifestyle photo versus the product-page photo is color-accurate for any given screen — we describe the color in words and offer free returns if it isn't right.
Fenwick boots: full-grain leather, Goodyear welt. Alder jeans: 12oz selvedge denim.

knowledgeDocs.title: return-policy
knowledgeDocs.body:
RETURNS & EXCHANGES POLICY.
Returns and exchanges are accepted within 30 days of delivery. Items must be UNWORN, unwashed, and have their original tags attached. Size exchanges are free when the requested size is in stock — we ship the new size and include a prepaid label for the original.
Worn, washed, or used items are NOT eligible for a standard return or exchange. The only exceptions are genuine manufacturing defects, which are handled case-by-case at Robin's discretion — there is no automatic entitlement to a return on a worn item.

knowledgeDocs.title: shipping-policy
knowledgeDocs.body:
SHIPPING POLICY.
Domestic (US): standard shipping is free on orders over $75, otherwise $6. Delivery is 3-5 business days after dispatch. We do not offer guaranteed delivery dates and cannot guarantee weekend or next-day arrival — we have no expedited or Saturday-guaranteed option.
International: we ship to Canada and the United Kingdom. Canada is a $15 flat rate, 6-10 business days; the customer is responsible for any duties or taxes charged at customs. We do not ship anywhere else at this time.
Tracking is emailed automatically when an order dispatches.

knowledgeDocs.title: size-chart
knowledgeDocs.body:
SIZE & FIT GUIDE.
Birch wool sweater: runs true to size — order your usual size. If you are between sizes, size down for a trimmer fit.
Alder straight-leg jeans: run true to size; numeric waist sizing (26-34).
Fenwick boots: run a half size large — most people size down a half size.
